body.x: DTS, (www.dts.com), a premier audio solutions provider for high-definition entertainment experiences, introduced DTS:X at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.DTS:X, the successor to DTS-HD Master, proves the company's object-based codec technology. It delivers the ultimate in flexibility, immersion and interactivity to listeners of all forms of entertainment. DTS:X solutions is also available for leading 2015 AV receiver silicon platforms representing the majority of the DSP platform market share, including Cirrus Logic, Analog Devices and Texas Instruments.
